name: The Crown of Will
summary: In Tarren Mill, Melisara prepares to weaken Mug'Thol's ogres before striking at their hold in the Ruins of Alterac. She sends you after the Crushridge maulers.

sections.title: Softening the Crushridge
sections.body: Mug'Thol and the Crushridge ogres hold the Ruins of Alterac. Melisara sees little chance of punishing Mug'Thol while so many ogres remain around him. First, their numbers must fall; only then can the next move begin. You are sent to hunt the Crushridge maulers.

sections.title: No Rest Yet
sections.body: Melisara sees ogre blood staining the snow after the maulers fall. The fighting will continue until the Crushridge are broken in spirit as well as in number.

faq.q: Who gives this part of The Crown of Will?
aliases: who gives the crown of will
faq.answer: Melisara gives you this work in Tarren Mill, and she is the one you return to.

faq.q: Where are the Crushridge ogres located?
faq.answer: Mug'Thol and his ogres have overrun the Ruins of Alterac, where the Crushridge now hold their ground.

faq.q: Why is Melisara targeting the maulers first?
faq.answer: Melisara says Mug'Thol will be hard to punish while his ogres remain so numerous. Their numbers must be thinned before her plan can go further.
